prompt: A 29-year-old man presents to primary care for worsening anxiety symptoms over the past few months. On the GAD-7 questionnaire, he reports the following over the last 2 weeks: feeling nervous, anxious, or on edge nearly every day; not being able to stop or control worrying more than half the days; worrying too much about different things nearly every day; trouble relaxing more than half the days; being so restless that it is hard to sit still on several days; becoming easily annoyed or irritable more than half the days; and feeling afraid as if something awful might happen nearly every day. What is his total GAD-7 score, and how should it be interpreted?

rubric_items.text: States the total GAD-7 score for this patient is 16 (exact integer match required).
States the clinical interpretation: Severe anxiety symptoms (accept equivalent wording).
